name: St. Filth
type_description: Aggro, Distortion, Effect, VCF (filter with distortion/harmonic saturation)
bom_parts_summary: TL074 op-amp; 2N3904 x2, 2N7000 x1 transistors; pots, jacks, switch, LED
components_evidence: BOM lists values and reference designators only (e.g. '1uf electrolytic (1) C1', '2N3904 (2) Q2, Q3', 'TL074 (1) U1'); no package/mounting type (0805, SOIC, DIP, TO-92, through-hole, SMD) is stated anywhere on the page, so mounting cannot be determined.

lineage.credit: Borrowed almost entirely from the Synthrotek DIRT filter, St. Filth ups the ante on lack of hygiene and social graces.
lineage.source_is: Synthrotek DIRT Filter, a 4HP eurorack low-pass filter / multi-effect (ring mod, wave shaping, harmonic distortion) module page
